description: Source code for PyRRef class and related functions handling Remote References (RRef) in PyTorch distributed RPC, including serialization, deserialization, and autograd backward support.

classes.name: PyRRef
classes.description: Class representing a Python Remote Reference (RRef) in PyTorch distributed RPC, supporting serialization, deserialization, and autograd backward.

methods.name: PyRRef
methods.description: Constructor for PyRRef wrapping an existing RRef.

methods.name: PyRRef
methods.description: Constructor creating a new owner RRef from a Python object with optional type hint.

methods.name: ~PyRRef
methods.description: Destructor for PyRRef, handling reference cleanup.

methods.name: getFuture
methods.description: Returns the JitFuture associated with the RRef's owner creation.

methods.name: getProfilingFuture
methods.description: Returns the profiling future if set.

methods.name: setProfilingFuture
methods.description: Sets the profiling future.

methods.name: isOwner
methods.description: Checks if this RRef is the owner.

methods.name: confirmedByOwner
methods.description: Checks if the RRef has been confirmed by its owner.

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns the WorkerInfo of the owner.

methods.name: ownerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the owner worker.

methods.name: toHere
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the RRef, possibly deserializing remote data.

methods.name: localValue
methods.description: Returns the local value of the RRef if owner.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RRef.

methods.name: createRRefProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy object for the RRef with specified type and timeout.

methods.name: getRRefType
methods.description: Gets the type of the RRef, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: pickle
methods.description: Serializes the RRef into a tuple for transfer.

methods.name: unpickle
methods.description: Deserializes a tuple into an RRef object.

methods.name: toIValue
methods.description: Converts the RRef to an IValue for serialization.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Performs backward autograd on the RRef's value.

methods.name: backwardOwnerRRef
methods.description: Performs backward autograd on the owner RRef's value.
